headline: eBay to lay off 9% of workforce to simplify operations
summary: eBay is cutting 9% of its workforce as part of an internal strategy to simplify operations and streamline its organizational structure.
why: eBay is a major global e-commerce platform whose operating margins and cost-structure adjustments are closely watched by tech and retail sector investors.

impacts.name: eBay
impacts.why: Reducing headcount lowers operational expenses but may indicate softer top-line growth or strategic realignments.
